french.usum: Ékaïser utilise la Force Z pour frapper l’ennemi de toutes ses forces. Augmente aussi ses stats.
french.lgpe: Ékaïser utilise la Force Z pour frapper l’ennemi de toutes ses forces. Augmente aussi ses stats.

german.usum: Grandiras greift Gegner mithilfe von Z-Kraft mit voller Wucht an. Zusätzlich werden seine Statuswerte erhöht.
german.lgpe: Grandiras greift Gegner mithilfe von Z-Kraft mit voller Wucht an. Zusätzlich werden seine Statuswerte erhöht.

spanish.usum: Kommo-o ataca con toda su fuerza al objetivo tras imbuirse del Poder Z. Además, potencia sus propias características.
spanish.lgpe: Kommo-o ataca con toda su fuerza al objetivo tras imbuirse del Poder Z. Además, potencia sus propias características.

italian.usum: Grazie al Potere Z, Kommo-o attacca i nemici con tutta la sua forza. Inoltre, aumenta le proprie statistiche.
italian.lgpe: Grazie al Potere Z, Kommo-o attacca i nemici con tutta la sua forza. Inoltre, aumenta le proprie statistiche.

english.usum: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Kommo-o, attacks the opposing Pokémon with full force. This move boosts the user’s stats.
english.lgpe: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Kommo-o, attacks the opposing Pokémon with full force. This move boosts the user’s stats.
english.swsh: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

effect.full: Inflicts sound-based damage to all opposing Pokémon and increases the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each. The user’s stats are not raised if the move fails to damage any opposing Pokémon.
effect.shortEffect: Inflicts damage to all opposing Pokémon and increases the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.
